chassis.summary: The two-wheel-drive Acty introduced with Honda’s 1990 update. Honda offered different gearboxes for the STD, SDX and SDX-II launch trims.

source.title: Honda Acty launch specifications
source.evidence: The M-HA3 columns list 2WD and the E07A engine.

chassis.summary: The Acty with Honda’s Real Time 4WD. The 1990 specifications list the Attack with an ultra-low forward and reverse range, alongside the SDX with a five-speed manual.

source.title: Honda Acty launch specifications
source.evidence: The M-HA4 columns list Real Time 4WD, the E07A engine, and the Attack and SDX trims.

chassis.summary: A ninth-generation Carry 4WD chassis. Suzuki’s September 1991 specification sheet shows both an extra-low plus five-speed gearbox and a four-speed gearbox with high and low transfer ranges, depending on trim.

source.title: Suzuki ninth-generation Carry spec sheet
source.evidence: Suzuki lists the F6A and different 4WD gearbox configurations across V-DD51T grades.

chassis.summary: Suzuki introduced the eleventh-generation Carry in 2013 with a short 1,905 mm wheelbase. Its launch spec sheet lists rear-wheel-drive and part-time four-wheel-drive configurations.

source.title: Suzuki eleventh-generation Carry spec sheet
source.evidence: The launch table lists 2WD and part-time 4WD with the R06A engine.
